summary: A firmware with a six-operator FM engine and a virtual analog engine, played as one six-voice instrument or as four mono tracks with patterns and a song arrangement. A Windows companion app manages sounds, projects, backups and installs.
features: 6-op FM with DX7-style patch import, plus virtual analog
Two banks of 64 instruments; 224-sound library with five profiles
Reorderable filter, drive, chorus, phaser, delay and reverb
16 projects, 16 patterns each, up to 64 steps; four-lane song mode
USB and TRS MIDI in, USB out, Bluetooth MIDI between two FMERs
USB audio of the main mix only; companion app is Windows-only
